OAT-03/S27.title: Generate on patient A, open patient B at once: A's dictation stays on A and nothing of A lands on B (both contexts)
OAT-03/S27.detail: PW, local stack, both modes (generateNote mocked, answered 8 s after it is asked, so A's note lands while B is open). A: dictation typed, Generate, then the app's back arrow and the list to B at once (no reload); B has its own encounter line. B's Post-Round right after opening and 45 s later and B's Encounter tab show nothing of A; B's stored note is empty and its encounter text is exactly its own line; back on A the Encounter tab holds A's dictation, the stored text equals it, and A's Post-Round shows A's own note. Judged 7/7 per mode. Every Generate used a 'procedure-other' custom note template because on 43c38a4f saving a generated note queues a server billing job (billing/persistence.ts enqueueBilling → ai/billing.ts run) that no socket mock can answer and that would reach Bedrock on this stack; the template only changes the (mocked) model's instruction text. Tripwire: no model call at all during the run.
